title: Marketing Account Manager
description:
Marketing Account Manager

Location: Runcorn, Cheshire (WA7)

Salary: £30,000- £33,000 (DOE)

Hours: Monday- Friday 09:00- 17:30

Contract: Permanent

Our client is a small, dynamic, high-impact agency in Cheshire, working with household brands that people know and trust. They deliver a full-service offering that spans brand strategy, TV, POS, and every touchpoint in between.

The Role

As the ambitious Marketing Account Manager , you will be in a hands-on role with the responsibility of a broad range of projects which includes advertising projects, branding and design etc. You will be working closely with client and creative teams, helping take briefs, manage projects and timings to ensure everything stays on track.

As the Marketing Account Manager your duties will be;
- Taking briefs, understanding client requirements and turning them into clear actions
- Working closely with creative teams to brief, coordinate and progress work
- Managing day-to-day client relationships and being a confident point of contact
- Managing multiple projects and keeping timings, budgets and deliverables on track
- Keeping clients updated and managing expectations.
- Spotting potential issues before they happen and finding practical solutions.
- Coordinating feedback and ensuring amends are clear and understood.
- Looking for opportunities to improve processes and ways of working

The successful Marketing Account Manager will have the following skills;
- Min of 3 years' Marketing Agency experience, ideally within an advertising, creative, design or integrated agency.
- Experience working within an Account Management role.
- Confident dealing directly with clients and building strong relationships.
- Well organised, commercially aware and comfortable managing multiple priorities
- Good understanding of the creative process and how an agency works.
- Strong communication skills and attention to detail
- Proactive, with the ability to think for yourself rather than simply following a process.
- Calm under pressure and good at keeping things moving.
- And, importantly, someone with a sense of humour!

What They Offer You
- A friendly, creative team who love what they do.
- Opportunity to work across a wide range of projects, brands and design styles.
- Genuine responsibility and exposure to well-known UK and international brands
- Team parties and outings, plus regular studio treats
- Competitive holiday allowance, including extra days off over Christmas.
- 5 days per week in the office, with the option to work from home 2 Fridays per month.
- Private healthcare with WPA and pension plan.
- Free parking

Apply now!

Click apply now if you are interested in this role!

title: Marketing and Business Development Executive
description:
Marketing & Business Development Co-ordinator

Location: Warrington

Salary: £30,000 - £35,000 DOE

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Working Hours: Monday to Friday, Office Based

The Opportunity

We are recruiting on behalf of an established and growing civil engineering business in Warrington that is looking to appoint a Marketing & Business Development Co-ordinator.

This is an exciting opportunity for a creative, commercially aware individual to take ownership of marketing activities while helping the business reach new clients and develop its presence within the market.

The company has an excellent reputation and an established client base but is keen to build on its success by introducing a more structured approach to marketing, client engagement and business development.

Working closely with the senior management team, you'll have the opportunity to introduce new ideas, develop marketing campaigns and play an important part in the company's continued growth.

The Role

This is a varied position combining hands-on marketing responsibilities with client relationship development and new business activity.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Planning and delivering marketing campaigns to raise awareness and generate new enquiries.
- Identifying potential clients and researching new business opportunities.
- Creating engaging content for LinkedIn, the company website and other marketing channels.
- Developing and maintaining relationships with existing and prospective clients.
- Supporting targeted email marketing campaigns and other promotional activities.
- Helping to increase the company's visibility across its target markets.
- Maintaining and developing an accurate database of clients and prospects.
- Identifying relevant industry events, conferences and networking opportunities.
- Working alongside the directors to develop and implement ideas that support business growth.
- Monitoring marketing activity and identifying opportunities for improvement.

As the role develops, there may also be opportunities to attend industry events and networking meetings to establish new contacts and build relationships with prospective clients.

About You

We're looking for someone who enjoys marketing but also understands the importance of building relationships and generating commercial opportunities.

Ideally, you'll bring:
- Previous experience in a marketing, marketing co-ordination or business development support role.
- Experience of digital marketing, social media and creating engaging content.
- Strong communication skills and the confidence to engage with business owners and senior decision-makers.
- A proactive approach, with the ability to identify opportunities and take the initiative.
- Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage several projects simultaneously.
- A good understanding of how effective marketing can support business growth.
- Confidence working independently while contributing to a small, collaborative team.

Experience within construction or engineering would be advantageous, although this is certainly not essential.

More importantly, we're looking for someone enthusiastic, resourceful and keen to make a difference.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £30,000 - £35,000 depending on experience.
- An opportunity to take ownership of marketing activities and introduce your own ideas.
- Direct involvement with the senior management team.
- A varied role offering both marketing and commercial exposure.
- Employee benefits scheme.
- Flexible working hours.
- Free on-site parking.
- A friendly, professional working environment.
- The opportunity to develop your responsibilities as the business continues to grow.

This is a particularly good opportunity for someone who enjoys the creative and strategic side of marketing but would also welcome the chance to become more involved in business development.

Interested?

If you're looking for a varied marketing role where your ideas will be valued and you'll have a genuine opportunity to contribute to business growth, we'd be keen to hear from you.

Apply today for a confidential discussion and further information.

Work Location: In person

title: Presenter and Content Creator
description:
Our client, a fast-growing marketing agency based in Warrington, are looking for an outgoing and enthusiastic Presenter and Content Creator to join their busy team! This is a full-time, permanent role, and is office based. Our client has two positions available for this role!

Benefits:
- Salary - £26,000 to £30,000 per annum, dependant on experience
- Monthly bonus incentives
- Working Hours - Monday to Friday, with 3 days of 9am to 5pm, and 2 days of 1pm to 10pm
- Holidays - 28 days Including Bank Holidays
- Access to the latest live streaming and production equipment!
- The chance to work with some of the top, industry-leading beauty and lifestyle brands

The Role:

Within this unique role, the successful candidate/s will be responsible for hosting TikTok live shopping events with the aim of successfully selling a range of different products to viewers. They will also be responsible for the production of these live events, managing the livestream set ups and ensuring the broadcasts run smoothly!

Day-to-Day of the Role:
- Present live shopping events on TikTok and other platforms, showcasing different products to live audiences
- Build rapport with the audience, answer questions as they come in and drive engagement about products
- Create content for top brands for different products
- Assist in the production of livestream events (full training will be provided!)
- Stay up to date with the latest product trends across TikTok and other platforms

What We're Looking For:
- A confident and outgoing individual, who will be comfortable showcasing products on camera!
- A strong communicator, with the ability to multi-task
- A passion for beauty and lifestyle products
- A background in digital marketing and content creation is preferred, however is by no means essential
- A willingness to learn about live event production, including the use of the latest live streaming production equipment

Please apply today if this role is right for you!
